title: Quenched Jamaican Pork Stew
description: A fermented, juicy pork stew with a tangy ketchup base, slow-blanched for a low-carb twist, perfect for a sick-day comfort meal.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the pork cubes, browning all sides for about 5 minutes.
Pour in the fermented ketchup and allspice, stirring to coat the meat.
Add the coconut milk and low-carb vegetable broth, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
After 1 hour, stir in the lime juice, salt, and black pepper, and continue simmering for another 30 minutes until the pork is tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then remove from heat.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
